name: skill-immo
description: Skill property-search: find property for sale in France (flats, houses, plots, parkings, premises) around an address, a street or a neighborhood, enriched with open data (DVF sales per type, rents, DPE, risks, condominiums, shops, travel times, crime, income) and the Stream Estate API v1, with a review and a score per listing, offer letters, and a local dashboard (map, kanban, list, dossier, market, follow-up)

stream_estate_api_key.title: Stream Estate API key
stream_estate_api_key.description: Optional, a key of the API v1 (api.stream.estate): listings from every portal, asking prices and alerts by Stream Estate (paid per item, 0.01 € each). Empty: open data and assisted listings (WebSearch, WebFetch, pasted text)
